description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application, setting up the root DOM node and rendering the main App component within StrictMode.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render the React application into, attaching it to the DOM element with ID 'root'.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM, in this case wrapping <App /> within React.StrictMode.
